name: story-monitor-ways
title: Monitor ways stories
description: Dot animations for page changes, sitemap changes, and extracted-record monitoring.
usage: The ways to monitor on a site product page, one picture per card. Exports `PageMonitorStory`, `SitemapMonitorStory` and `ExtractMonitorStory`. Each plays only on screen; with reduced motion they show the diff, the changed list, the scored record.
avoid: Stories as the main content of a page

reference.scope: Tokenized, framework-independent adaptation. Public measurements cover shared styles; retained variants are not a claim of current public-page parity.
